subject: US State Privacy Exhibit — service provider role & cross-state dataflow clarification
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@northbridge.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: US State Privacy Addendum - Service Provider Exhibit

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our standard "Service Provider Exhibit" we ask vendors to complete for US state privacy compliance (CCPA/CPRA + selected state exhibits). Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept the exhibit as-is or if you require edits?

Key clarifications we need up-front:
- confirmation that Redwood is acting as a service provider/processor (limited use)
- subprocessors: notice period for onboardings and a current subprocessor list
- deletion timing and data return window for covered personal information
- whether telemetry/operational logs used for service optimization are subject to sale
- cross-state transfers and any reliance on sale/interstate transfer exceptions

I've included Tomas Rivera (privacy) in cc for any legal details. Attachment: NB_SP_Exhibit_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB).

Best,
Elena
Elena Garcia
Director, Vendor Risk & Privacy
Northbridge Health

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@northbridge.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: US State Privacy Addendum - Service Provider Exhibit

Thanks Elena — got the exhibit and appreciate the clear list. A few quick confirmations and asks from our side:

On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 3:23 PM Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@northbridge.io> wrote:
> Hi Alex,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our standard "Service Provider Exhibit" we ask vendors to complete ...

High-level: Redwood will take the service provider/processor role (limited use) for customer content and personal data processed to provide the inference service. We do want to confirm a couple of operational points before we sign:

1) Subprocessor onboarding notice — we typically provide a 30-day notice for new subprocessors. For certain infrastructure-level subprocessors (e.g., cloud GPU hosts), we ask for a 14-day notice to avoid blocking urgent capacity fixes. Can you indicate which notice you expect to receive?

2) Deletion / retention — we follow customer-configured retention by default; for telemetry we retain aggregated, de-identified metrics. For covered personal information, our default is 90 days for request/rollback windows after contract termination unless customers require otherwise.

3) Telemetry / sale exception — Redwood does not sell personal data; telemetry used for service ops is covered by limited use and is not marketed. We'll confirm wording to explicitly exclude telemetry from any sale definition.

4) Cross-state transfers — we treat transfers within the US as internal routing for service delivery. If Northbridge requires explicit language about sale/interstate transfer exceptions, we can add a clause stating transfers are for service provision and limited use only.

Neha — can you review the attached and suggest precise redlines on: subprocessor notice period, deletion timeframe, and the telemetry carve-out? Monica — looping you for CS confirmation on retention options we can reasonably offer to customers during onboarding.

I attached a short set of notes inline as a separate doc (sending next) and happy to hop on a 30-minute call if you prefer.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: US State Privacy Addendum - Service Provider Exhibit (redline suggestions)

Alex / Monica — quick internal guidance and proposed redlines we should send back to Northbridge:

- Service provider role: Acceptable. Keep explicit sentence: "Redwood acts solely as a service provider/processor and will process Customer Personal Information only to provide the Services and as directed by Customer."

- Subprocessors: Propose two-tier notice: 30-day notice for non-infrastructure subprocessors; 14-day notice for infrastructure/cloud providers and emergency patches. Also propose a standing CSV of active subprocessors (updated monthly) and a security contact for urgent escalation.

- Deletion / return: Propose 90 days by default; allow customers to request expedited deletion (30 days) in contract addendum. For backup retention we commit to overwriting media within 180 days.

- Telemetry & sale: Add explicit carve-out: telemetry that is aggregated/hashed and not linkable to a consumer is not "sale" and is used only for service improvement and safety. Include sample phrasing.

- Cross-state transfers: Add clause that internal routing and replication to US regions is for service delivery; not a sale. If Northbridge requires an explicit affidavit on interstate transfer, provide one under MNAs on request.

Attachments I'll provide: a redline PDF (US_Privacy_Addendum_Redline.pdf) with tracked changes and a current subprocessor list (subprocessor_list_20261125.csv). If legal at Northbridge wants live edits we'll do a quick Zoom; otherwise we can accept electronic signature once they confirm the subprocessor notice window.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@northbridge.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@northbridge.io>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: US State Privacy Addendum - Service Provider Exhibit

Thanks Alex & Neha — grateful for the fast turnaround and the clear redlines. Two items from our side:

1) Subprocessor notice period — Northbridge legal prefers a 30-day standard notice for all new subprocessors. We realize infrastructure providers can be time-sensitive; if you must keep the 14-day carve, we need an obligation to notify us immediately and provide rollback/mitigation steps for any emergency onboarding.

2) Deletion timing — 90 days default is acceptable. Northbridge will add a clause for a 30-day expedited deletion option at additional cost; please confirm you can support secure deletion and provide certificates of destruction or equivalent evidence.

Also, please share the CSV subprocessor list and the redline PDF. We'll route to procurement but would like to keep the signature flow going this week. I'll send the contract via DocuSign once legal confirms the notice wording.

DocuSign preview link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc-123-northbridge-addendum

Best,
Elena

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@northbridge.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: US State Privacy Addendum - Service Provider Exhibit (next steps)

Elena — thanks, and appreciate the pragmatic approach. Summary & next steps from Redwood: 

- Subprocessor notice: We can accept Northbridge's preference for a 30-day notice as the baseline. For infrastructure emergency onboarding we will keep a 14-day operational carve with mandatory immediate notification and documented rollback/mitigation steps; we will add that language to the redline.

- Deletion / evidence: We confirm 90-day default plus an expedited 30-day delete option (implementation may require additional operational fees per SOW). Redwood will provide attestation/certificate of deletion for covered customer data upon request; for backups we will overwrite per our backup policy (max 180 days).

- Telemetry / sale language: we will add explicit exclusion language per Neha's note.

Attachments (for your review): US_Privacy_Addendum_Redline.pdf (tracked changes) and subprocessor_list_20261125.csv (current list). HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890.

If legal at Northbridge confirms the subprocessor notice language, we are ready to accept DocuSign and move to signatures. Monica, can you be on the procurement call if they request an expedited deletion SOW?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
